android.desc:
Hanuman - The Divine Protector, an immersive game journey with a unique blend of mystical and adventure gaming experience. Our devotion to Lord Shri Ram and Hanuman is at the heart of this epic quest, offering a fresh take on classic tales.

Join Hanuman on his divine odyssey, traversing through four distinct worlds teeming with adventure and mystery. Each world boasts 20+ captivating levels, adorned with picturesque landscapes and captivating challenges.

As a devout disciple of Adipurush, Hanuman's journey is filled with spiritual significance and thrilling encounters. Engage in exhilarating gameplay as you collect fruits, laddus, coins etc to progress through the game's enchanting levels.

Features:
• Enjoy uninterrupted gameplay with offline mode.
• Traverse through four unique worlds: Chitrakoot, Ayodhya, South India, Himalaya, Sri Lanka and Jungles.
• Unlock new levels and challenges by collecting fruits, laddus and coins.

Prepare to be captivated by the divine allure of "Hanuman - The Divine Protector". Experience the joy of devotion and the thrill of adventure in this unforgettable gaming experience!
